name: Nurse Week Sticker Pack (50 Pieces)
seoTitle: Nurse Stickers Pack for Nurses Week Gifts
metaDescription: A pack of 50 nurse themed stickers that splits easily across a whole unit, making it a cheerful, budget friendly Nurses Week gift or goodie bag filler.
summary: Fifty nurse themed stickers that are easy to share across a unit, a simple way to add something fun to Nurses Week treats or thank you cards.
whyItWorks: Charge nurses and unit managers know the challenge of Nurses Week: you want everyone on the floor to get something, including the night shift and the part time staff who are easy to miss. A 50 piece sticker pack splits nicely. Drop a few into each goodie bag with a snack and a handwritten note and the whole team gets a little something without a big bill.

Stickers also have a long life in nursing culture. They end up on water bottles that go to every shift, on laptops used for school, on planners where nurses track their schedules, and on the backs of phone cases. They are a small way for someone to show pride in the work they do. For one nurse, the pack is a fun add on to a bigger present like a tumbler. For a nursing student club or a preceptor group, it becomes an easy giveaway at a meeting or a pinning celebration.
goodToKnow: Look at the listing photos to see the designs, since mixed packs vary in style and tone.
Check the listing for whether the stickers are waterproof vinyl if they are going on bottles or cups.
Plan on about three to five stickers per person if splitting the pack for a unit.

faq.q: Is this enough for a whole unit during Nurses Week?
faq.a: For a small or midsize unit, a few stickers per person works well. Larger departments might want two packs so every shift gets some.

faq.q: Are these appropriate for a professional setting?
faq.a: Mixed nurse packs are usually lighthearted rather than crude, but check the listing images if you are gifting to a conservative workplace.
